=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py: check(), the `for header in diff.splitlines():` loop | severity=NIT | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: `str.splitlines()` also splits on U+2028, U+2029, U+0085, \x0b, \x0c and \x1c-\x1e, not only on newlines. An added agents.md line that contains one of these followed by text shaped like `@@ -a,b +c,d @@` is read as a second hunk header.
  WHY: The spurious header changes the added and removed counts. It can only produce a false violation (stricter), never skip a real hunk.
- changelog.d/6902-agents-md-direct-edit-check.md: the paragraph text "It fails when an `agents.md` or `AGENTS.md` hunk outside `## Repo-tree (auto-generated)` only inserts lines" | severity=NIT | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment describes the exemption as the whole section, while the checker exempts only lines strictly between TREE markers.
  WHY: The changelog contradicts README.md, the agents.d fragment and the script, and may lead contributors to expect prose elsewhere in the section to be exempt.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The PR description says the script "logs `AGENTS_MD_DIRECT_EDIT outcome=ok|violation|skipped|error`".
  Expected change site: scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py, main()
  Evidence of absence: main() emits only `ok`, `violation` and `error`. The earlier `skipped` path was changed to `outcome=error reason=invalid_ref`. README.md, the agents.d fragment and the changelog all list `ok|violation|error`, so the code and docs agree and only the PR description is stale. This is a documentation mismatch, not a functional gap.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py: `for header in diff.splitlines():` (inside `check()`, after the `diff = _git(repo_root, "diff", "-U0", ...)` line) | severity=NIT | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: `str.splitlines()` splits on Unicode line separators as well as `\n`/`\r`; content followed by hunk-header-shaped text can be parsed as a second hunk header.
  WHY: Git diff itself only emits `\n` separators, so the trigger requires an `agents.md` line containing one of the listed Unicode characters followed by hunk-header-shaped text; the false hunk may register a false violation.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "It fails when an `agents.md` or `AGENTS.md` hunk outside `## Repo-tree (auto-generated)` only inserts lines, or when its hunks add more than `AGENTS_MD_DIRECT_NET_ADD_MAX` lines beyond the lines they replace." (PR description lead paragraph and `changelog.d/6902-agents-md-direct-edit-check.md` lead paragraph)
  Expected change site: `changelog.d/6902-agents-md-direct-edit-check.md` body paragraph describing the check's exemption
  Evidence of absence: LAST RUN narrowed the exemption from the whole `## Repo-tree (auto-generated)` section to only the lines strictly between `<!-- TREE:START ... -->` and `<!-- TREE:END ... -->` markers (`scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py:_generated_spans` and the rewritten exemption test) and updated `README.md:1221-1243` and `agents.d/6902-agents-md-direct-edit-check.md` to say "outside the generated TREE-marker blocks of `## Repo-tree (auto-generated)`", but `changelog.d/6902-agents-md-direct-edit-check.md` still says "hunk outside `## Repo-tree (auto-generated)`" without naming the TREE-marker scope, so a contributor reading the changelog is told the whole section is exempt while the README in the same release contradicts it.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "It logs `AGENTS_MD_DIRECT_EDIT outcome=ok|violation|skipped|error` and exits 0, 1 or 2." (PR description "`## Changes`" bullet 1 for `scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py`)
  Expected change site: `scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py`, `main()`
  Evidence of absence: The success path emits `AGENTS_MD_DIRECT_EDIT outcome=ok` (after the `if not violations` block), the violation path emits `outcome=violation`, and the error paths emit `outcome=error` (`invalid_ref`, `git_failed`). No branch in `main()` emits `outcome=skipped`. The CI step's `if:` condition also omits the step entirely on a project's final PR and a forward-merge fallback PR rather than emitting `skipped`. The script's docstring (lines 28–30) likewise documents only `ok|violation|error`. The PR description's `ok|violation|skipped|error` enumeration has no matching implementation.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
